name: @hypaware/crush
description: Crush client adapter for HypAware. Reads each project's crush.db read-only (LLP 0573), found through Crush's projects.json index, and materializes sessions/messages into ai_gateway_messages via the shared ai_gateway.projected_exchange materializer: a backfill provider for history and a poll source for ongoing capture. No gateway proxying, no changes to Crush.

config_sections.summary: Crush adapter config: enabled, data_dirs, poll_interval.
